authority: W3C Recommendation; contains 86 normative success criteria. W3C Understanding and Techniques pages are informative.

criteria.title: Non-text Content
criteria.symptom: Image, icon, CAPTCHA, diagram or control has no equivalent non-text alternative or a misleading one
criteria.remediation: Write purpose-equivalent alt text; use empty alt on purely decorative images; label icon controls; provide structured long descriptions for complex visuals
criteria.verification: Inspect accessibility tree and screen reader output for functional and informative images, then verify decorative images are ignored
criteria.exceptions_and_pitfalls: Alt text must communicate purpose not pixels; CAPTCHA requires alternatives for different sensory modalities

criteria.title: Audio-only and Video-only (Prerecorded)
criteria.symptom: Prerecorded audio lacks an equivalent transcript or silent video lacks an equivalent alternative
criteria.remediation: Provide a text equivalent for audio-only and text or equivalent audio track for video-only
criteria.verification: Compare all information and events in the media to the alternative including speakers and meaningful sound
criteria.exceptions_and_pitfalls: Does not replace caption requirements for synchronized video with audio

criteria.title: Captions (Prerecorded)
criteria.symptom: Prerecorded synchronized video speech or meaningful sound is inaccessible to deaf users
criteria.remediation: Provide accurate synchronized captions including speaker identification and meaningful non-speech sounds
criteria.verification: Review timing, completeness, names, sound effects and readability with captions enabled
criteria.exceptions_and_pitfalls: Auto-generated captions are not automatically accurate; media alternatives for text have a specific exception

criteria.title: Audio Description or Media Alternative (Prerecorded)
criteria.symptom: Important visual action in prerecorded synchronized media is missing from spoken information
criteria.remediation: Provide audio description or an alternative for time-based media conveying meaningful visual information
criteria.verification: Compare narrative, diagrams, gestures and on-screen text to spoken descriptions or complete alternative
criteria.exceptions_and_pitfalls: Level A allows either option; 1.2.5 at AA specifically requires audio description

criteria.title: Captions (Live)
criteria.symptom: Live synchronized audio lacks usable live captions
criteria.remediation: Provide a reliable real-time captioning service for live synchronized media
criteria.verification: Observe a live session for delay, completeness, sound identification and speaker distinction
criteria.exceptions_and_pitfalls: A transcript published afterward does not replace live captions while broadcasting

criteria.title: Audio Description (Prerecorded)
criteria.symptom: Prerecorded video contains visually conveyed information not available through audio
criteria.remediation: Provide synchronized audio description for key visual information, using pauses or suitable described version
criteria.verification: Test the described track against actual visual information and verify playback selection
criteria.exceptions_and_pitfalls: A transcript alone does not satisfy this AA criterion

criteria.title: Sign Language (Prerecorded)
criteria.symptom: Prerecorded synchronized media lacks sign language interpretation
criteria.remediation: Provide qualified sign language interpretation for the audio portion of prerecorded synchronized media
criteria.verification: Review signed track with appropriate language-fluent reviewers and check synchronized presentation
criteria.exceptions_and_pitfalls: The choice of sign language is audience-specific; captions alone are not the same

criteria.title: Extended Audio Description (Prerecorded)
criteria.symptom: Normal audio gaps are too short to narrate visual information
criteria.remediation: Provide extended description that pauses the video when needed to convey information
criteria.verification: Review described content for full coverage with extensions and accessible controls
criteria.exceptions_and_pitfalls: Only relevant where ordinary audio descriptions cannot communicate sufficient detail

criteria.title: Media Alternative (Prerecorded)
criteria.symptom: Prerecorded synchronized or silent media lacks complete text-based equivalent
criteria.remediation: Provide a complete alternative for time-based media including speech, visual events and interactions
criteria.verification: Compare the media sequence end-to-end to alternative and assess equivalent information
criteria.exceptions_and_pitfalls: A short synopsis is not a complete media alternative

criteria.title: Audio-only (Live)
criteria.symptom: Live audio-only information has no equivalent accessible alternative
criteria.remediation: Provide a contemporaneous alternative for time-based media with equivalent information
criteria.verification: Observe actual live delivery and verify equivalence, completeness and timeliness
criteria.exceptions_and_pitfalls: Post-event transcript is not a live equivalent

criteria.title: Info and Relationships
criteria.symptom: Visual headings, labels, tables, lists and groups disappear or become misleading in semantic structure
criteria.remediation: Use native headings, lists, tables with headers, form labels and fieldsets; express relations in DOM or text
criteria.verification: Inspect semantic tree and linearized content with screen reader; verify headers and group labels
criteria.exceptions_and_pitfalls: An aria role alone cannot repair a fundamentally wrong native control or reading model

criteria.title: Meaningful Sequence
criteria.symptom: DOM or screen reader order differs from essential visual sequence
criteria.remediation: Align DOM order with meaningful reading order; avoid CSS reordering that changes only visual flow
criteria.verification: Navigate linearized reading and reading order at desktop and mobile widths
criteria.exceptions_and_pitfalls: Only sequences affecting meaning are in scope, not all visual positioning

criteria.title: Sensory Characteristics
criteria.symptom: Instructions identify a target only by color, location, shape, size or sound
criteria.remediation: Pair sensory descriptions with persistent text labels or unambiguous semantic names
criteria.verification: Attempt task without color or spatial cues; verify instructions still identify controls
criteria.exceptions_and_pitfalls: Color may supplement language but cannot be the only clue

criteria.title: Orientation
criteria.symptom: Layout locks portrait or landscape without necessity
criteria.remediation: Support both orientations with adaptive layout and preserved functions
criteria.verification: Rotate physical or emulated device in each task state and test all functionality
criteria.exceptions_and_pitfalls: Specific orientation can be essential for genuinely constrained content; document evidence

criteria.title: Identify Input Purpose
criteria.symptom: User-personal-information fields lack machine-readable purpose despite known autocomplete tokens
criteria.remediation: Use correct HTML autocomplete tokens such as name, email, street-address, tel for eligible fields
criteria.verification: Inspect computed autocomplete token and confirm autofill semantics for personal data
criteria.exceptions_and_pitfalls: Applies only to fields collecting information about user with purposes enumerated by WCAG

criteria.title: Identify Purpose
criteria.symptom: Regions, UI components or icons have no programmatically identifiable purpose
criteria.remediation: Provide consistent semantics and accessible purpose metadata with supported methods
criteria.verification: Inspect landmarks, icon semantics and accessible tree for the intended purpose
criteria.exceptions_and_pitfalls: Support for specific purpose vocabularies varies; avoid assuming arbitrary ARIA tokens work

criteria.title: Use of Color
criteria.symptom: Error, selection, link or chart series is identified only by hue
criteria.remediation: Add text labels, shapes, patterns, underlines or non-color indicators
criteria.verification: Review grayscale or forced-color mode and check meaning remains available
criteria.exceptions_and_pitfalls: Contrast alone does not solve color-only information encoding

criteria.title: Audio Control
criteria.symptom: Audio autoplays for more than 3 seconds without independent stop or volume control
criteria.remediation: Avoid autoplay; otherwise provide pause/stop or independent audio volume control
criteria.verification: Start page and confirm immediate keyboard-operable control for qualifying autoplay audio
criteria.exceptions_and_pitfalls: Non-interference criterion applies even to otherwise non-relied-upon content

criteria.title: Contrast (Minimum)
criteria.symptom: Readable foreground text has insufficient contrast with background
criteria.remediation: Use at least 4.5:1 for ordinary text and 3:1 for large text; evaluate text over images and states
criteria.verification: Measure rendered colors across interaction states and themes, then manually inspect overlays and imagery
criteria.exceptions_and_pitfalls: Logos and qualifying incidental content are exceptions; do not confuse with non-text contrast

criteria.title: Resize Text
criteria.symptom: Text at 200% zoom or text-only enlargement clips, overlaps or hides functionality
criteria.remediation: Use fluid relative typography and containers; remove fixed-height text boxes
criteria.verification: Increase text up to 200% without assistive technology and finish representative tasks
criteria.exceptions_and_pitfalls: Captions and images of text have stated exceptions; resizing via browser zoom may need complementary tests

criteria.title: Images of Text
criteria.symptom: Critical text is rasterized or baked into images instead of real text
criteria.remediation: Render information as selectable HTML/CSS text when presentation can be achieved with technology
criteria.verification: Inspect important graphic text at zoom and verify user styling and machine readability
criteria.exceptions_and_pitfalls: Essential presentation, customizable images of text and logos have exceptions

criteria.title: Contrast (Enhanced)
criteria.symptom: Normal text below 7:1 or large text below 4.5:1
criteria.remediation: Choose color tokens meeting enhanced thresholds across all text and modes
criteria.verification: Measure actual rendered foreground/background pairs in default and active states
criteria.exceptions_and_pitfalls: Logo and incidental exceptions apply; AA thresholds alone do not satisfy AAA

criteria.title: Low or No Background Audio
criteria.symptom: Background sounds interfere with spoken content in prerecorded audio-only material
criteria.remediation: Remove background, provide background-off track, or keep sound at least 20 dB lower except brief sounds
criteria.verification: Listen critically and measure levels for the qualifying audio recordings
criteria.exceptions_and_pitfalls: Applies to primarily foreground speech, with CAPTCHA, audio logo and musical exceptions

criteria.title: Visual Presentation
criteria.symptom: Users cannot adjust presentation of blocks of text to readable widths, colors or spacing
criteria.remediation: Offer a mechanism for customizable foreground/background, width, alignment, spacing and resizing
criteria.verification: Exercise all specified text presentation adjustments with representative paragraphs
criteria.exceptions_and_pitfalls: This is AAA customization for blocks of text, not mandatory identical styling for all UI

criteria.title: Images of Text (No Exception)
criteria.symptom: Non-essential information is encoded as an image of text
criteria.remediation: Replace informational text graphics with real text; preserve images only for decoration or essential presentation
criteria.verification: Audit all informative images of text, including banners and headings
criteria.exceptions_and_pitfalls: AAA removes the AA customizable-image exception; logos can remain essential

criteria.title: Reflow
criteria.symptom: Zoom or narrow view forces two-dimensional page scrolling to read standard content
criteria.remediation: Use responsive layout, wrap text and collapse columns; contain truly 2D widgets locally
criteria.verification: At 320 CSS px wide for vertical content and 256 CSS px high for horizontal content verify no information or function loss
criteria.exceptions_and_pitfalls: Tables, maps, diagrams and other intrinsically 2D parts have limited exceptions, not whole-page exemption

criteria.title: Non-text Contrast
criteria.symptom: State indicators, input boundaries or essential chart marks blend into adjacent colors
criteria.remediation: Ensure required UI identification and meaningful graphics achieve at least 3:1 contrast with adjacent colors
criteria.verification: Measure required visual indicators in all states and inspect meaningful graphic parts
criteria.exceptions_and_pitfalls: Inactive UI and unmodified user-agent appearance have exceptions; not all decorative outlines are required

criteria.title: Text Spacing
criteria.symptom: Content clips or buttons break when users override spacing
criteria.remediation: Allow line-height 1.5, paragraph-spacing 2x font, letter-spacing .12em and word-spacing .16em with no loss
criteria.verification: Inject all four overrides simultaneously and inspect fields, dialogs, navigation and content
criteria.exceptions_and_pitfalls: This tests resilience to user changes, not a rule that sites must default to those values

criteria.title: Content on Hover or Focus
criteria.symptom: Tooltips or popovers vanish before they can be read, obscure content or cannot dismiss
criteria.remediation: Make triggered content dismissible where required, hoverable and persistent until permitted dismissal
criteria.verification: Hover/focus, move pointer into popup, press Escape and verify timing and dismissal behavior
criteria.exceptions_and_pitfalls: There are exceptions to dismissibility for error content or content not obscuring other content

criteria.title: Keyboard
criteria.symptom: Feature works only via pointer, drag or gesture when keyboard equivalent is possible
criteria.remediation: Use native keyboard-operable controls; implement expected keys for custom widgets
criteria.verification: Complete every function with keyboard only including menus, uploads and overlays
criteria.exceptions_and_pitfalls: Some input depending on path of movement has a narrow exception, not permission for pointer-only navigation

criteria.title: No Keyboard Trap
criteria.symptom: Keyboard focus enters widget but cannot leave using ordinary keyboard action
criteria.remediation: Provide normal Tab/Shift+Tab escape or clear instructions for nonstandard exit
criteria.verification: Keyboard through all components and confirm focus can exit; test overlays and embedded content
criteria.exceptions_and_pitfalls: Non-interference applies even to non-conforming third-party content

criteria.title: Keyboard (No Exception)
criteria.symptom: Content relies on non-keyboard movement paths even when keyboard alternative possible
criteria.remediation: Supply keyboard control for every function with no path-dependent exception
criteria.verification: Operate all features using only keyboard across every meaningful state
criteria.exceptions_and_pitfalls: AAA removes the path-based exception of 2.1.1

criteria.title: Character Key Shortcuts
criteria.symptom: Unmodified letter, number or punctuation shortcuts trigger during speech input or typing
criteria.remediation: Allow turning them off, remapping to a modifier, or limit activity to focused component
criteria.verification: Test shortcuts with focus in input fields and with voice dictation-like single characters
criteria.exceptions_and_pitfalls: Applies to single-character shortcuts; shortcuts with modifiers are outside this rule

criteria.title: Timing Adjustable
criteria.symptom: Session or form expires without allowed time adjustment or exception
criteria.remediation: Provide time-limit off, 10x adjustable, or advance warning with at least 20 seconds and at least ten extensions
criteria.verification: Reproduce timer expiry; verify exact exception or turn-off, adjustable, extend path
criteria.exceptions_and_pitfalls: Real-time, essential and 20-hour exceptions are conditional; security may require tailored evaluation

criteria.title: Pause, Stop, Hide
criteria.symptom: Moving, blinking, scrolling or auto-updating information prevents reading and has no required control
criteria.remediation: Provide pause, stop, hide or adjustable update mechanism where the specific movement/update conditions apply
criteria.verification: Observe duration, automatic start, concurrency and controls for moving and auto-updating regions
criteria.exceptions_and_pitfalls: There are distinct conditions for movement and auto-updating information; essential animation exception

criteria.title: No Timing
criteria.symptom: Task success depends on a nonessential timer
criteria.remediation: Remove time limits unless intrinsically part of real-time events or non-interactive synchronized media
criteria.verification: Complete scenarios at arbitrarily slow user pace and inspect exceptions
criteria.exceptions_and_pitfalls: AAA has narrower exceptions than 2.2.1

criteria.title: Interruptions
criteria.symptom: Nonemergency interruptions steal attention or input during important tasks
criteria.remediation: Allow users to postpone or suppress interruptions except emergencies
criteria.verification: Exercise notifications during form entry and complex flows; verify deferral path
criteria.exceptions_and_pitfalls: Emergency alerts are an explicit exception

criteria.title: Re-authenticating
criteria.symptom: Session expiry discards entered content after login renewal
criteria.remediation: Persist activity state through reauthentication without compromising security
criteria.verification: Let session expire mid-task, authenticate again and confirm previous task can continue
criteria.exceptions_and_pitfalls: Security design can preserve state without extending expired authentication credentials

criteria.title: Timeouts
criteria.symptom: User is not warned that inactivity can cause data loss
criteria.remediation: At start, disclose possible data loss after inactivity unless data is preserved for more than 20 hours
criteria.verification: Review notification and test inactivity persistence, recovery and loss
criteria.exceptions_and_pitfalls: A user must be informed about inactivity-based data loss, not necessarily given control over all timeouts

criteria.title: Three Flashes or Below Threshold
criteria.symptom: Flash effects exceed safe threshold and risk photosensitive reactions
criteria.remediation: Avoid flashing or verify under three flashes per second or below general/red-flash threshold
criteria.verification: Inspect video and animations with suitable flashing analysis and specialist review
criteria.exceptions_and_pitfalls: Dangerous flashing can interfere with whole page; never treat reduced-motion alone as sufficient

criteria.title: Three Flashes
criteria.symptom: Any page material flashes more than three times per second
criteria.remediation: Remove or slow flashes so content never exceeds three per second
criteria.verification: Evaluate all looping animation, video and transitions against strict frequency limit
criteria.exceptions_and_pitfalls: AAA does not permit the below-threshold alternative allowed at A

criteria.title: Animation from Interactions
criteria.symptom: Nonessential interaction-triggered motion causes discomfort with no disable option
criteria.remediation: Honor reduced-motion preference or provide a way to disable nonessential animation
criteria.verification: Set prefers-reduced-motion and trigger every motion-capable interaction
criteria.exceptions_and_pitfalls: Essential motion is exempt; user preference must also affect scripted/canvas animation

criteria.title: Bypass Blocks
criteria.symptom: Repeated navigation must be traversed on every page before main content
criteria.remediation: Provide working skip navigation or equivalent bypass to main content
criteria.verification: Keyboard Tab from page start and verify activation lands at meaningful main region
criteria.exceptions_and_pitfalls: Landmarks support navigation but an inaccessible or inert skip link still harms users

criteria.title: Page Titled
criteria.symptom: Browser tab title is blank, generic or misleading
criteria.remediation: Set a unique descriptive document title reflecting page purpose
criteria.verification: Inspect title across routes and client-side navigation including errors
criteria.exceptions_and_pitfalls: Changing heading text does not update document title automatically

criteria.title: Focus Order
criteria.symptom: Focus sequence breaks intended meaning or operation after modal/menu/layout changes
criteria.remediation: Align focus navigation with meaningful order and manage focus on state transitions
criteria.verification: Tab/Shift+Tab through dialogs, cards and responsive layouts in both directions
criteria.exceptions_and_pitfalls: Positive tabindex often hides structural problems and is rarely a good repair

criteria.title: Link Purpose (In Context)
criteria.symptom: Many identical vague links lack discoverable destination or action
criteria.remediation: Use specific link text or associated programmatically determinable context
criteria.verification: Review link text and programmatic context with screen reader links navigation
criteria.exceptions_and_pitfalls: Context must be available to assistive technology; nearby visual text alone might not count

criteria.title: Multiple Ways
criteria.symptom: There is no second means to locate a page within a set of pages
criteria.remediation: Provide navigation plus search, sitemap, index or another genuine way to find pages
criteria.verification: Find representative pages through at least two mechanisms
criteria.exceptions_and_pitfalls: Pages that are a step in a process are excluded; one-page applications need scope judgment

criteria.title: Headings and Labels
criteria.symptom: Sections or form controls have unclear or misleading headings and labels
criteria.remediation: Write descriptive headings and labels matching purpose, keep semantics intact
criteria.verification: Ask a reviewer to navigate headings and identify purposes without surrounding context
criteria.exceptions_and_pitfalls: This requires descriptive headings and labels where present, not a prescribed exact heading hierarchy

criteria.title: Focus Visible
criteria.symptom: Keyboard focus exists but has no visible indication
criteria.remediation: Preserve or create visible high-clarity focus styles for all keyboard-operable UI
criteria.verification: Tab through all interactive elements and confirm current focus indicator is perceivable
criteria.exceptions_and_pitfalls: WCAG 2.1 2.4.7 does not itself prescribe the newer WCAG 2.2 focus appearance metrics

criteria.title: Location
criteria.symptom: Users cannot tell where they are in a group of related pages
criteria.remediation: Provide breadcrumbs, hierarchical page map or equivalent location information
criteria.verification: Navigate nested pages and verify current location is consistently indicated
criteria.exceptions_and_pitfalls: AAA applies to a set of pages; not all single views need a breadcrumb

criteria.title: Link Purpose (Link Only)
criteria.symptom: Link purpose cannot be recognized from link text alone
criteria.remediation: Use self-contained descriptive accessible link names
criteria.verification: List links out of context in screen reader and verify purpose remains clear
criteria.exceptions_and_pitfalls: Ambiguity to users in general is an exception; differs from in-context A rule

criteria.title: Section Headings
criteria.symptom: Long body content has no useful section divisions
criteria.remediation: Organize body content into labelled sections with meaningful headings
criteria.verification: Read content via headings navigation and assess logical segments
criteria.exceptions_and_pitfalls: This criterion is about content sections rather than every custom UI control

criteria.title: Focus Not Obscured (Minimum)
criteria.symptom: Keyboard focus moves to a control completely covered by an author-created sticky header, banner, modal layer or footer.
criteria.remediation: Ensure the focused component is not entirely hidden behind author-created content. Adjust overlay geometry, scroll padding and scroll margins; on focus programmatically reveal the target where necessary.
criteria.verification: Tab and Shift+Tab through every control with sticky bars, drawers, validation and responsive states; confirm at least part of each focused component is visible.
criteria.exceptions_and_pitfalls: The minimum permits partial visibility. Consider movable content initial positions and user-opened overlays that can be dismissed without moving keyboard focus; do not confuse focus appearance or focus indicator visibility with control visibility.

criteria.title: Focus Not Obscured (Enhanced)
criteria.symptom: A focused field or button is partially cut off by an author-created overlay or sticky element.
criteria.remediation: Keep the entire keyboard-focused component unobscured by author-created content at all relevant screen sizes and zoom levels; reserve inset space and adjust scroll alignment.
criteria.verification: Keyboard-traverse all elements with overlays, sticky headers, footers and error banners active; confirm the whole component remains visible.
criteria.exceptions_and_pitfalls: Unlike 2.4.11 AA, partial visibility is not enough; determine whether occlusion is actually author-created and test complex dynamic states.

criteria.title: Focus Appearance
criteria.symptom: The keyboard focus indicator is so thin or subtle that the active control cannot be distinguished.
criteria.remediation: Provide a strong focus indicator meeting the area equivalent to a 2 CSS-pixel perimeter (or equivalent) and 3:1 pixel change contrast between focused and unfocused states; preserve clear geometry.
criteria.verification: Compare focused/unfocused rendering using pixel samples and measure indicator area; test at zoom, browser themes and high-contrast settings.
criteria.exceptions_and_pitfalls: Do not mistake 2.4.7 Focus Visible for this quantitative AAA rule. User-agent-controlled, non-author-adjustable indicators and indicators not distinguishable from the component itself have narrow defined exceptions; verify normative text.

criteria.title: Pointer Gestures
criteria.symptom: Pinch, multi-finger or path-based drag is the only way to operate a feature
criteria.remediation: Provide single-pointer alternative without path gesture such as buttons to zoom or reorder
criteria.verification: Perform all gesture-requiring actions with a single click/tap sequence
criteria.exceptions_and_pitfalls: Exception when a path-based or multipoint gesture is essential to function

criteria.title: Pointer Cancellation
criteria.symptom: Touch down or mouse down causes irreversible action too early
criteria.remediation: Trigger actions on up-event with abort/undo or use one of the other permitted patterns
criteria.verification: Press and move pointer away before release; ensure activation is canceled or undoable
criteria.exceptions_and_pitfalls: Essential down-event actions have an exception; evaluate touch and mouse

criteria.title: Label in Name
criteria.symptom: Accessible name differs from visible button label, breaking voice activation
criteria.remediation: Include exact visible label words in accessible name, preferably at start
criteria.verification: Compare visible labels to computed accessible names for controls and voice commands
criteria.exceptions_and_pitfalls: Additional context is allowed, but visible words need to appear in name

criteria.title: Motion Actuation
criteria.symptom: Feature requires shaking, tilting or body movement without accessible alternative
criteria.remediation: Offer on-screen control and option to disable motion activation
criteria.verification: Operate function without motion and verify motion sensor can be disabled
criteria.exceptions_and_pitfalls: Exceptions for accessibility-supported interfaces and motion essential to function

criteria.title: Target Size
criteria.symptom: Small touch target is difficult to activate
criteria.remediation: Make targets at least 44 by 44 CSS px or meet an explicit exception
criteria.verification: Measure rendered target boxes on touch viewport and evaluate adjacent controls
criteria.exceptions_and_pitfalls: WCAG 2.1 AAA uses 44x44; do not substitute WCAG 2.2 AA target size 24x24 rule

criteria.title: Concurrent Input Mechanisms
criteria.symptom: Using one input type disables another available modality unnecessarily
criteria.remediation: Keep mouse, touch, stylus and keyboard mechanisms concurrently usable
criteria.verification: Switch modalities midtask and confirm state and function persist
criteria.exceptions_and_pitfalls: Essential, security and user-setting exceptions are possible

criteria.title: Dragging Movements
criteria.symptom: Reordering cards, moving a slider or drawing a route requires a continuous pointer drag without a simple alternative.
criteria.remediation: Provide a single-pointer operation without dragging for the same function: move-up/down controls, a click-to-place mode, direct setting, or accessible alternative.
criteria.verification: With touch or mouse, complete the full drag action using discrete presses or clicks without sustained dragging; verify keyboard operation independently.
criteria.exceptions_and_pitfalls: Dragging that is essential or performed by the user agent rather than authored interaction may be excepted; a keyboard-only alternative is not by itself sufficient for this pointer criterion.

criteria.title: Target Size (Minimum)
criteria.symptom: Small icon buttons or densely packed links cause missed activation for users with tremor or limited dexterity.
criteria.remediation: Give pointer targets at least 24 by 24 CSS pixels or ensure their applicable 24 CSS-pixel diameter spacing geometry satisfies the criterion. Enlarge hit areas without disrupting visual rhythm.
criteria.verification: Measure actual clickable geometry and spacing at tested zoom and responsive breakpoints; exercise tight controls via touch and pointer.
criteria.exceptions_and_pitfalls: Exceptions include equivalent controls, inline links, controls whose size is set by user agent and not altered, essential presentation, and applicable spacing. Do not confuse 24 CSS px AA with 44 CSS px AAA 2.5.5.

criteria.title: Language of Page
criteria.symptom: Screen reader pronounces all page content using wrong language
criteria.remediation: Set correct html lang for document's default human language
criteria.verification: Inspect lang and use assistive technology to listen to representative text
criteria.exceptions_and_pitfalls: Locale metadata and visual language switcher do not replace correct document language

criteria.title: Language of Parts
criteria.symptom: Foreign-language passage is spoken with wrong pronunciation rules
criteria.remediation: Mark passages with appropriate lang attributes where language changes
criteria.verification: Inspect language changes and listen with supported screen reader and voice
criteria.exceptions_and_pitfalls: Proper names, technical terms, indeterminate language and vernacular borrowings are excepted

criteria.title: Unusual Words
criteria.symptom: Jargon or unusual words are not explained
criteria.remediation: Provide a definition or explanation for jargon, idioms and unusual usages
criteria.verification: Review unfamiliar passages with representative readers and locate meaning on demand
criteria.exceptions_and_pitfalls: This is AAA and may be fulfilled by a mechanism for finding definitions

criteria.title: Abbreviations
criteria.symptom: Abbreviation expansion is inaccessible or unknown
criteria.remediation: Provide a mechanism for discovering expansions or meanings of abbreviations
criteria.verification: Test each ambiguous abbreviation in context using appropriate expansion method
criteria.exceptions_and_pitfalls: Context-specific meanings matter; abbr title alone may not work reliably in every assistive technology

criteria.title: Reading Level
criteria.symptom: Text requires advanced reading ability with no accessible explanatory alternative
criteria.remediation: Provide supplemental content or a version at lower secondary education reading level where applicable
criteria.verification: Assess text after removing proper names/titles and verify suitable supplementary explanation
criteria.exceptions_and_pitfalls: Not a simplistic instruction to shorten all technical material; criterion has defined scope

criteria.title: Pronunciation
criteria.symptom: Meaning depends on pronunciation but no pronunciation guidance exists
criteria.remediation: Provide accessible pronunciation or phonetic guidance where needed
criteria.verification: Identify ambiguous terms where pronunciation affects meaning and inspect cues
criteria.exceptions_and_pitfalls: Applies when pronunciation is necessary to understand meaning, not all unfamiliar words

criteria.title: On Focus
criteria.symptom: Focusing a control unexpectedly navigates or changes context
criteria.remediation: Keep focus passive; trigger meaningful context change only through explicit action
criteria.verification: Tab through controls without activation and monitor route, focus and context
criteria.exceptions_and_pitfalls: Showing help on focus is not automatically a prohibited context change

criteria.title: On Input
criteria.symptom: Changing selection automatically submits, navigates or moves focus without warning
criteria.remediation: Use explicit submit/update control or provide advance notice of context change
criteria.verification: Change all form values and verify no unannounced context-changing side effect
criteria.exceptions_and_pitfalls: Changing a value may update related content without being a context change

criteria.title: Consistent Navigation
criteria.symptom: Repeated navigation appears in different relative order across related pages
criteria.remediation: Use shared navigation component with stable ordering and placement
criteria.verification: Compare repeated navigation sequences across multiple routes and states
criteria.exceptions_and_pitfalls: User-initiated change of layout or menu arrangement is permitted

criteria.title: Consistent Identification
criteria.symptom: Same function is called different names or represented by changing icons
criteria.remediation: Use consistent accessible names, text and icons for same functionality
criteria.verification: Compare common actions across pages and responsive layouts
criteria.exceptions_and_pitfalls: Different functions can appropriately use different labels even if visually similar

criteria.title: Change on Request
criteria.symptom: An automatic context change happens without request or disable mechanism
criteria.remediation: Make context transitions user-initiated or offer a mechanism to turn off automatic changes
criteria.verification: Navigate and interact under idle and input transitions; inspect requests and options
criteria.exceptions_and_pitfalls: AAA requirement is stronger than the A focus/input requirements

criteria.title: Consistent Help
criteria.symptom: Help chat, contact details or support links change relative order between pages in a multi-page process.
criteria.remediation: When a repeated help mechanism appears on multiple pages, preserve its relative position in the sequence of those pages. Use shared page shells/components.
criteria.verification: Visit every in-scope page in the process and compare relative order of recurring help controls in DOM/focus/navigation sequence.
criteria.exceptions_and_pitfalls: Does not require adding help to pages lacking it; applies to repeated help mechanisms, such as human contact, human assistance, self-help, or automated contact.

criteria.title: Error Identification
criteria.symptom: Form marks fields red but does not identify errors in text
criteria.remediation: Name the fields in error and describe each error textually
criteria.verification: Submit invalid data, inspect messages and screen reader announcements
criteria.exceptions_and_pitfalls: Error identification does not guarantee suggestion quality; also inspect 3.3.3

criteria.title: Labels or Instructions
criteria.symptom: Users do not know what information to enter or what format is required
criteria.remediation: Provide persistent associated labels and relevant instructions before entry
criteria.verification: Review empty form and error states with keyboard and assistive technology
criteria.exceptions_and_pitfalls: Placeholder text alone is often not a reliable persistent label

criteria.title: Error Suggestion
criteria.symptom: System reports invalid input but no correction advice where one is known
criteria.remediation: Provide clear actionable suggestion unless doing so compromises security or purpose
criteria.verification: Enter foreseeable errors and inspect repair guidance in text and assistive technology
criteria.exceptions_and_pitfalls: Suggestion must be possible and safe; do not leak sensitive security data

criteria.title: Error Prevention (Legal, Financial, Data)
criteria.symptom: Irreversible high-stakes submission lacks review, correction or reversal route
criteria.remediation: Offer reversible submission, correctable validation, or confirmation/review before finalization
criteria.verification: Run legal, financial, stored-data and test-answer submissions; verify one permitted safeguard
criteria.exceptions_and_pitfalls: Applies only to defined legal, financial, data and test response situations

criteria.title: Help
criteria.symptom: Users cannot find instructions or help for complicated input
criteria.remediation: Provide contextual guidance, contact details, or help mechanisms
criteria.verification: Complete difficult flows while looking for assistance at each key field
criteria.exceptions_and_pitfalls: AAA does not prescribe persistent live chat; right-sized help can qualify

criteria.title: Error Prevention (All)
criteria.symptom: Ordinary data submission lacks any reversal, error check or review process
criteria.remediation: Provide reversible entry, validation opportunity or review-and-confirm for user submissions
criteria.verification: Submit ordinary user data and verify at least one safeguard
criteria.exceptions_and_pitfalls: AAA expands 3.3.4 beyond high-stakes submission categories

criteria.title: Redundant Entry
criteria.symptom: A checkout or onboarding flow forces users to retype previously entered data in the same process.
criteria.remediation: Autopopulate previously entered values or provide a way to select them. Preserve explicit user correction, privacy and secure handling of sensitive fields.
criteria.verification: Complete a multi-step flow with known data; confirm repeat fields are populated or selectable rather than require recollection or typing.
criteria.exceptions_and_pitfalls: Exceptions include essential re-entry, information no longer valid and re-entry needed for security. Do not invent the contents of secrets, and do not reuse data outside the same process.

criteria.title: Accessible Authentication (Minimum)
criteria.symptom: Login or 2FA blocks users behind a memory, transcription or puzzle task without a suitable alternative.
criteria.remediation: Support authentication without a cognitive function test, or provide an allowed mechanism/alternative: password-manager-friendly fields and paste, passkeys, secure magic links, accessible device-based flow, or other compliant assistive path.
criteria.verification: Verify password-manager/autofill and paste work, evaluate every sign-in/reset/recovery/MFA path, and independently test allowed alternatives with relevant users/assistive technologies.
criteria.exceptions_and_pitfalls: The criterion has defined exceptions including an assisting mechanism, recognizing objects, and identifying personal content; these are not a blanket approval for inaccessible CAPTCHAs or insecure workarounds.

criteria.title: Accessible Authentication (Enhanced)
criteria.symptom: An authentication method still requires object recognition or identifying personal content as a cognitive hurdle.
criteria.remediation: Provide a reliable route that avoids cognitive function tests or a permitted assistance mechanism; design passkey/autofill/paste-friendly login and accessible recovery as integrated functionality.
criteria.verification: End-to-end test sign-in, recovery and second factor without cognitive-memory or object-recognition requirements; verify the assistance path works across devices.
criteria.exceptions_and_pitfalls: AAA is stricter than 3.3.8 AA: recognizing objects and identifying personal content are not listed exceptions. Protect account security and avoid confusing an alternative login method with evidence that every barrier is resolved.

criteria.title: Name, Role, Value
criteria.symptom: Custom control lacks accessible name, correct role or exposed state and value
criteria.remediation: Prefer native elements; otherwise implement correct ARIA role, state, value and interaction behavior
criteria.verification: Inspect accessibility API tree; operate custom widget via keyboard and screen reader
criteria.exceptions_and_pitfalls: ARIA attributes do not implement interaction, focus or native browser behavior by themselves

criteria.title: Status Messages
criteria.symptom: Async validation, search results or success updates are invisible to assistive technology unless focus moves
criteria.remediation: Use role=status, appropriate aria-live regions or role=alert for critical updates without forcing focus
criteria.verification: Trigger async state changes while focus stays in place and confirm screen reader announcements
criteria.exceptions_and_pitfalls: Avoid excessive assertive live regions or duplicative announcements; errors may need focus separately

derived_from: WCAG 2.1 updated recommendation: 78 criteria; 4.1.1 Parsing removed, nine new criteria added.
